description: This file defines a final class DemoModeFilter that implements a RestAssured filter used in testing to intercept HTTP requests and return mock responses in demo mode. It handles specific API endpoints like authentication validation and job titles management, providing deterministic fake responses to simulate backend behavior during testing.
